I claim for them nothing more than does a scientist, who, though he conducts his experiments with the utmost accuracy,, forethought and minuteness, never claims* any finality about his conclusions, but keeps an open mind regarding them. situation. Yet I am far from claiming any finality, or infallibility about my conclusions. One claim I do indeed make and it is this. For me they appear to be absolutely correct, and seem for the time being to be final. For if they were not, I should base no action on them.. But at every step I have carried out the process of acceptance or rejection and acted accordingly. And so long as my acts satisfy my reason and my heart, I must firmly adhere to my original conclusions.
